description: This PHP source file defines the SearchFormView class responsible for rendering and managing the search form UI in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing the view, displaying the form with dynamic options, and generating pagination sizes based on configuration.

classes.name: SearchFormView
classes.description: A class extending View that manages the display and configuration of the search form in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchFormView with the template path.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and assigns search form options and configurations for rendering.

methods.name: makeSizesFromConfig
methods.description: Creates an array of pagination sizes based on configuration, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: makeSizes
methods.description: Generates an array of sizes from min, step, and max parameters, with validation.
